name: Mouse Tooltip Translator
summary: Translates text in a tooltip when you hover over it or select it on a web page. It also handles PDF files, YouTube dual subtitles, text in images through OCR, and spoken pronunciation.
audience: Readers of foreign-language web pages, PDFs and videos who want translations without leaving the page.
pros: Translates on hover or on text selection
Works on PDFs, YouTube dual subtitles and images through OCR
Can read the translated text aloud
Also published for Edge and Firefox
cons: Translation relies on third-party services (Google and Bing translators)
AI is not a core feature of the extension
